summary: User UI review rejected the current P15 frontend as not matching mainstream usable system style and flow. The generated package remains a technical trial package only. P15 ordinary-user runtime browser E2E proved several functional fixes, but the frontend is still organized too much like an engineering configuration console: large hand-written App.ts, inline create forms above tables, card/form/table stacking, and insufficient task-level page design. PM/reviewer must not treat this as a normal user-ready system UI.
